summary: Connect one query row's scaled query-key scores and softmax weights to the weighted sum of value vectors produced by one attention head.
objective: Select one query token, inspect every scaled score and softmax weight, and verify how those weights aggregate value vectors into the head output.
intent_signals: Explain how one attention head computes weights and mixes value vectors.
Show tensor shapes for Q, K, V, attention weights, and one output row.
example_prompts: Visualize one scaled dot-product attention head for a short token sequence and let me verify the value-vector weighted sum.
not_for: Claiming that attention weights explain the final model prediction.
Combining several heads without their projections and output matrix.
Treating a causal mask as a learned low weight.

entities.name: Query-key score row
entities.guidance: For selected query i, expose each dot product q_i dot k_j, the division by sqrt(d_k), any explicit mask, and the resulting softmax input. Keep tensor shapes visible.

entities.name: Attention weights
entities.guidance: Use a table, ribbons, or bars whose linear scale represents alpha_ij. Show the row sum and distinguish masked zeros from small learned weights.

entities.name: Value-vector mixture
entities.guidance: Show o_i=sum_j alpha_ij v_j in the actual d_v-dimensional state. A 3D point cloud or convex hull is a declared projection of value space, and the projected output must be obtained by applying the same linear display projection to o_i.

state_contract.model: One head with Q in R^(n_q x d_k), K in R^(n_k x d_k), V in R^(n_k x d_v). Compute logits=QK^T/sqrt(d_k), apply the declared mask before a row-wise softmax alpha, then O=alpha V in R^(n_q x d_v). Use n_q=n_k only for self-attention; cross-attention may differ.
state_contract.authority: Q, K, V, d_k, mask, and the selected query row own all scores, weights, and outputs. Any 3D projection is a display map from d_k or d_v dimensions and never changes the tensor calculation.
actions: Select a query row and inspect its per-key products, scaled logits, mask, weights, and output.
Toggle a valid causal mask and recompute softmax after setting forbidden logits to negative infinity.
Edit one supplied vector component or load another fixture and recompute all dependent rows.
Switch between actual-coordinate tables and labeled 3D projections.
Reset tensors, mask, query selection, and camera.

invariants: For each nonempty permitted key set, attention weights are nonnegative and sum to 1 within tolerance.
O has shape n_q by d_v and each row equals the independently recomputed alpha row times V.
A causal mask yields exactly zero displayed probability for forbidden future keys after softmax.
If the 3D value view uses a linear projection P, the displayed output is P(o_i)=sum_j alpha_ij P(v_j); no nonlinear embedding may be presented as preserving this barycentric identity.
motion_guidance: Reveal score, scale, mask, softmax, and value sum as ordered explanatory stages driven by one frozen tensor state.
A moving ribbon or particle shows aggregation order only; matrix multiplication has no implied physical transit time.
creative_affordances: Use ribbons, matrix tiles, vector balances, or a compact tensor laboratory while keeping exact values accessible.
A projected convex-hull view may complement the table when its axes and linear projection are declared.
known_limits: One attention head does not include multi-head concatenation, the output projection, residual connections, normalization, or downstream layers.
Attention weights describe this head's value mixture; they are not by themselves a faithful causal explanation of a model prediction.
A 3D projection shows at most three display coordinates of d_k- or d_v-dimensional vectors.
Authored recipe and prospective checks only; no model forward pass, scene, or rendered result was run or observed.

claims.statement: Scaled dot-product attention computes softmax(QK^T/sqrt(d_k))V, so each query row's softmax weights form the coefficients of a weighted sum of value vectors.
claims.scope: One scaled dot-product attention operation with its declared mask and row-wise softmax.

source_refs.locator: Section 3.2, equation 1, and Section 3.2.3 masking description

claims.statement: In the NLP models studied by Jain and Wallace, learned attention weights were often uncorrelated with gradient-based feature-importance measures, and substantially different attention distributions could yield equivalent predictions.
claims.scope: The models and tasks tested in the NAACL 2019 study; this supports a caution, not a theorem about every attention mechanism.

object_craft.structure: Keep query, key, score, mask, probability, value, and output objects separately selectable. Align rows and token identities across matrix, ribbon, and projected-vector views.
object_craft.material: Use signed styling for logits, bounded styling for probabilities, and distinct outlines for masked entries. Text and shape preserve meaning without color.

physical_contract.scope: Tensor-derived geometry and staged explanation; no physical flow or causal-attribution model.
checks: Recompute row softmax and O=alpha V from displayed tensors.
Verify the declared display projection does not alter the underlying tensor state.
